objective: Fix the schema (dataset fields) panel copying an entire row when a single cell is selected.
tests_added: SchemaPanel: Ctrl+C with one cell selected copies only that cell's text
SchemaPanel: a 2x2 range selection copies only the selected columns
design_decisions: Root cause measured, not assumed: serialize_table_widget_to_tsv read selectionModel().selectedIndexes() only for row numbers and then rebuilt the cell list as rows x every column, discarding the column half of the selection. SchemaPanel already used SelectionBehavior.SelectItems, so the selection itself was correct.
The helper was originally written for _CopyTableWidget in value_counts_window, which uses SelectRows, where whole-row output was accidentally correct.

Fix keeps the real (row, column) pairs and maps row numbers to compacted frame positions, letting the existing serialize_to_tsv rules handle per-row column ordering and discontiguous selections. Row-behavior tables are unaffected because their selectedIndexes() already covers every column.
results: 632 tests pass; ruff check, ruff format, and ty check are clean.
